properties.controlling_annotation: August 7 western dry/wet transition: within the area actually walked and observed during the mapped sections, the inspector states that the ground west and north of the walked transition was dry, and the ground east and south was wet. This does not classify unwalked or visually unobserved acreage.
properties.inspector_clarification: The area described as dry was dry when observed on August 7. The inspector states that it was not necessarily dry continuously since the prior rain; it dried during the intervening days. Do not interpret 'dry' as proof that the area does not become wet after rain or remains dry year-round.
properties.limitation: The same filtered walked-line geometry carries both directional side annotations. It is not a surveyed wet/dry boundary or an acreage classification.

properties.statement: Land outside the area actually walked or visually observed remains unclassified by the August 7 wet/dry interpretation.
